Definition
[Soul] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0483, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0484 1. appi:1.20,appi:1.21\group Soul theory A submanifold $S\subset \N $ is totally geodesic when its second fundamental form vanishes; its normal bundle is $\nu (S)=\{ V\in T_p\N :p\in S,\ \langle V,T_pS\rangle =0\} $. A soul is a compact, totally convex, totally geodesic submanifold.
